# Reed College LibGuides

> > Research guides and library resources for Reed College students, faculty, and researchers in Portland, Oregon.

Reed College LibGuides provides comprehensive research support across disciplines, with specialized guidance for thesis writing, linguistics, classical studies, and other academic areas. The platform serves as the primary gateway to library resources and academic support services for the Reed College community.

## Key Topics

- Reed College Library
- Thesis writing and formatting
- Research guides
- Academic support services
- LibGuides platform
- Senior thesis resources
- Linguistics research
- Greek, Latin, and Ancient Mediterranean Studies
- Academic writing
- Student resources
- Library databases and journals
- Portland, Oregon
- Springshare LibApps
- Creative Commons licensing

## Library Home & Core Resources

- [Home - LibGuides at Reed College](https://libguides.reed.edu/index.php): Reed College Library homepage for research guides and resources

## Thesis Support & Academic Writing

- [Formatting - Thesis Help 2025-26](https://libguides.reed.edu/thesis/formatting): Thesis formatting guidelines for Reed College students 2025-26
- [Library Resources for Seniors - Thesis Help 2025-26](https://libguides.reed.edu/thesis/information): Library resources and support for Reed College seniors writing theses

## Discipline-Specific Research Guides

- [Phonetics & Phonology - Linguistics](https://libguides.reed.edu/linguistics/phonetics-phonology): Research guide for phonetics and phonology in linguistics studies
- [Articles & Journals - Greek, Latin, and Ancient Mediterranean Studies](https://libguides.reed.edu/glam/articles): Articles and journals for Greek, Latin, and Ancient Mediterranean studies
